requirement: Implement a property-based test harness for a payload serializer TokenPayloadEncoder. All inputs must be supplied exclusively through pure Hypothesis strategies (hypothesis.strategies.integers(), hypothesis.strategies.text()). Mixing standard library random.randint() or time.time() inside test execution breaks deterministic shrinking and is strictly prohibited.
skeleton: A serializer encode_token_payload(user_id, role, salt) and property verification function check_roundtrip_invariant(user_id, role, salt).

rationale.teaches: A property test whose inputs come only from Hypothesis strategies, a role strategy that filters out the separator, a round-trip check that propagates errors, and a validator that accepts user_id 0.
rationale.why: A property that derives its own randomness or swallows errors passes every example, and a role containing the separator corrupts the encoding only for that input. The fixture runs the property with fixed examples and checks shrinking reproduces.

candidates.why_wrong: The salt is remixed through a linear congruential step, so the encoded salt no longer matches the input Hypothesis provided.
The salt is hardcoded to 0, so the round-trip check ignores the generated salt.
The role strategy does not filter out colons, so a role containing the separator corrupts the encoded token.
ValueError is caught and True returned, so a broken encoder passes the property.
user_id 0 is rejected with <= 0, so the smallest valid id fails.
